description:
Record a refund for a confirmed order: marks it refunded, revokes its items and its receipt. Chain Daddy never holds the buyer's tokens — send the refund yourself from the payout wallet, then pass its transaction hash here.

Params: store_id, order_id, refund_tx_hash?, note?, session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, order: Order}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404, HTTP_409 (not refundable in its status)

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

refund_tx_hash.description: Your refund transfer's transaction hash / signature

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_refund_order
title: Record a refund
